The '''1995–96 [[Czech First League]]''' was the third season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in the [[Czech Republic]].

==League changes==

'''Relegated to the [[1995–96 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[Bohemians 1905|Bohemians Prague]]
* [[SK Benešov|Benešov]]

'''Promoted from the [[1994–95 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[SFC Opava|Opava]]
* [[FC Slovácká Slavia Uherské Hradiště|Uherské Hradiště]]
